title: Affine pushout ring section presentation
statement: The affine pushout ring has a second inclusion section map whose counit is the identity and whose products with the first inclusion additively generate every affine section.

proof.text: Construct δ explicitly as t composed with the ring inverse-image adjunction unit on V. Apply the hypothesis t≫ε=e and the ring adjunction right triangle to prove ε(δ(c))=c.

Apply the affine section ring pushout comparison. Compare it with CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct by isoIsPushout to construct a ring equivalence C tensor_D C ≃ B(W). The two inclusion equations identify c tensor 1 with b(c) and 1 tensor d with δ(d); multiplicativity gives the pure-tensor formula.

Use surjectivity of the ring equivalence and TensorProduct.induction_on. Zero corresponds to the empty list, c tensor d to the singleton [(c,d)], and addition to concatenation. Additivity and List.sum_append prove the desired finite-sum formula.

theorem affine_pushout_ring_section_presentation [IsAffineHom f]
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u})
    (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B) (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf)
    (hring : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t ∧ b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf ∧ t ≫ ε = e₀)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) := (f.app V).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ δ : Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) →+* B.obj.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
      (∀ c, (ε.hom.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).hom (δ c) = c) ∧
      (∀ r : B.obj.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
        ∃ l : List (Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) × Γ(U, f ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
          r = (l.map fun x ↦ (b.hom.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).hom x.1 * δ x.2).sum)
